cases.case_label: LINE element insertion in ABHD5 intron 3 causing aberrant splicing in Chanarin-Dorfman syndrome
cases.mechanism_detail: No coding-sequence mutation was found, but RT-PCR on patient skin RNA showed a 101 bp insertion between exons 3 and 4 in all four patients of a large consanguineous family. Sequencing and bioinformatics traced this to a LINE element inserted into intron 3, which causes aberrant splicing of the mutant intron 3.
cases.quote: Bioinformatic analysis and direct sequencing indicated that this insertion resulted from an exceptional mutational event, namely, the insertion of a LINE element into intron 3 of the ABHD5 gene, leading to aberrant splicing out of the mutant intron 3.
